resources.string: File name or keyword, e.g. invoice PDF

Use an installed file manager to find downloaded files matching: %1$s. Check Downloads first and use search if available. Report the file names and visible locations, then stop on the matching file list. Do not open, move, rename, share or delete files. If permission is required or no match is found, explain it clearly.
A specific question, e.g. how to remove limescale from a kettle

Use an installed browser to open https://www.baidu.com and search for: %1$s. Read up to 3 relevant accessible results and summarize useful answers with their titles and source links. Do not invent results, download anything or sign in. If the network or a login/captcha blocks progress, stop and explain what happened.
App and keyword, e.g. Kuaishou, tomato and egg recipe

Find content in an installed app for this request: %1$s. Open the specified app, use its search and stop on the results page. Report what results are visible. Do not send, follow, like, purchase, download or change settings. If the app is missing or requires login/captcha, stop and explain; do not install an app or sign in.
Choose a task and add your needs, or write your own below.
Your task is saved. Finish setup, then review it before running.
Choose a provider and enter your API key.
Key encrypted on this phone. Your provider account is billed.
Alibaba preset uses the standard Beijing API, not a Coding Plan subscription. Other regions can be configured in Advanced.
Provider changed. Enter the key for this provider.
This model always uses thinking. The provider does not support switching it off.
Thinking is off by default where supported. Tool calls are checked before any device action.
Could not connect. Check the key, model access, and your provider balance.
Stop the current task before changing setup.
Wukong needs Android’s permission to operate your phone. Follow the next screen once; already-paired phones can reconnect automatically when wireless debugging is available.
Allow floating controls so you can stop tasks and approve sensitive actions while Wukong works in other apps.
Your model and phone are connected. Review your task, then start it yourself.
Android asks you to approve this connection. No computer or extra app is needed.
Wireless debugging needs Wi-Fi. Connect to a trusted network, then return here.
Open About phone and tap Build number seven times. Some phones use the system version entry. Return here when Developer options is enabled.

1. Tap Continue to open Wireless debugging. Turn it on.
2. Choose Pair device with pairing code. Keep that dialog open.
3. Pull down notifications and enter the six-digit code in Wukong’s notification.
Wukong will finish connecting automatically.
Your pairing is saved. Turn on Wireless debugging; Wukong will try to reconnect. You do not need to pair again unless Android has forgotten this connection.
You can return to your task now.
Allow notifications so you can enter the code without closing Android’s pairing dialog. Manual pairing is available under troubleshooting.
e.g. Find the invoice PDF I downloaded
Action was not performed. Observing and adjusting…
Remove the saved provider and API key from this phone? You will need to configure a model before running another task.
